description: This file defines the 'LimitStream' class, a decorator implementing the StreamInterface to provide a bounded view of an underlying stream with optional offset and byte limit functionalities.

classes.name: LimitStream
classes.description: A decorator class that provides limited read access to an underlying stream, with support for setting offsets and limits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LimitStream with an underlying stream, optional limit, and optional offset.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the limited stream has been reached.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the limited subset of data available for reading.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position within the limited stream, respecting the limit and offset.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position relative to the start of the limited stream.

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: Sets the starting offset within the underlying stream from which the limit applies.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of bytes allowed to be read from the stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads data from the underlying stream, respecting the set limit and offset.
